name: USD/CHF Dual MA Crossover - Variable Position Sizing
description: Long/short strategy on USD/CHF using 20/50/200-day SMAs on 1-hour timeframe. Enters long when 20-day SMA crosses above 50 or 200, enters short when crossing below. Position size: 1 contract for 20×50 cross, 2 contracts for 20×200 cross. Holds until next crossover signal.
source:
# USD/CHF Dual MA Crossover - Variable Position Sizing
# Long/short on 20/50/200-day SMA crossovers with variable sizing

# Data source - 1H timeframe
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1H)()
close = src.c

# Moving averages (converting days to 1H periods: 20d=480, 50d=1200, 200d=4800)
sma_20 = ma(period=480, type=MAType.sma)(close)
sma_50 = ma(period=1200, type=MAType.sma)(close)
sma_200 = ma(period=4800, type=MAType.sma)(close)

# Crossover signals for 20×50
cross_up_50 = crossover(sma_20, sma_50)
cross_down_50 = crossunder(sma_20, sma_50)

# Crossover signals for 20×200
cross_up_200 = crossover(sma_20, sma_200)
cross_down_200 = crossunder(sma_20, sma_200)

# Combined entry signals
long_entry = cross_up_50 or cross_up_200
short_entry = cross_down_50 or cross_down_200

# Hold signals until opposite crossover
held_long = hold_until()(enter=long_entry, exit=short_entry)
held_short = hold_until()(enter=short_entry, exit=long_entry)

# Execute long/short zones
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long, short_entry=held_short)

# Position sizing: 2 contracts for 200-day cross, 1 contract for 50-day cross
# Determine size at signal time
is_200_cross = cross_up_200 or cross_down_200
size_at_cross = 2.0 if is_200_cross else 1.0

# Capture size when any crossover signal fires
any_cross = long_entry or short_entry
captured_size = valuewhen()(condition=any_cross, source=size_at_cross)

# Apply position sizing (unit = contracts)
position_size(type="unit")(size=captured_size)
